_note: Upcoming community meetings and neighborhood-group events shown in the carve-out box on the homepage front page. Civic meetings come from the 34th Ward newsletter (Conway's Corner); the Indivisible Greater West Loop events come from that chapter's Mobilize page (mobilize.us/indivisiblegwlchi). Optional fields: 'org' (a small source label) and 'url' (makes the title a link). Exact venues for the Indivisible events are gated behind RSVP, so 'location' is only filled where publicly verified and the link carries the rest. The homepage shows only future-dated items, soonest first, and drops them once they pass. Refresh Indivisible events from their Mobilize page.
